_comment: One reading per rule-carrying item: the item's title and check copied literally, the
verdict, the reading, and an answer for every shape tools/audit_item_readings.py detects.
Edited by hand only. A copy that no longer matches the registry is a pair nobody has re-read.

CI-001.title: Ensure URL Is Indexed
CI-001.reading: The title asks whether the URL is indexed, which only Google knows; `rows` carries indexability_matrix's verdict, which lists what would stop indexing — robots.txt, status, noindex in meta or header, a canonical elsewhere. CI-002 asks Google.

shapes.external: Indexing is Search Console's to report; this rule reads the page's own blockers, and `measures` says so.

CI-002.title: Confirm Google Has Indexed the Audited URL
CI-002.reading: `indexed` is URL Inspection's own coverage verdict for the audited URL, from Search Console.

CI-003.title: Page Returns 200 (OK) Status Code
CI-003.reading: `rows.0.status` is the entry URL's final status, asserted equal to 200.

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical is the status name, not a second subject.

CI-004.title: Allow Indexing via Meta Robots
CI-004.reading: `meta_robots` is the page's robots meta content; the rule passes when no directive says noindex and when the tag is absent.

shapes.external: The word is *Indexing*, but the title's subject is the meta tag, which the page itself carries; no search engine data is needed.

CI-005.title: Do Not Block the URL in robots.txt
CI-005.reading: `rows.0.robots_allowed` is the RFC 9309 answer for Googlebot on the entry URL, from lib/robots_rules.

CI-006.title: Declare Sitemap Location in robots.txt
CI-006.reading: `sitemaps` lists the Sitemap: lines robots.txt declares; one is what the title asks.

shapes.existential: The title asks that the location be declared; one declaration satisfies it.

CI-008.title: Make the URL Discoverable via Internal Links/Navigation
CI-008.reading: `orphan_pages.count` is sitemap URLs the crawl found no internal link to, robots refusals excluded.

shapes.conjunction: Links/Navigation names one subject: an inbound internal link, navigation included.

CI-009.title: Serve Content at a Single Canonical URL
CI-009.reading: `rows` maps canonical_checker's verdict: self-canonical or canonicalised passes, cross-host or missing fails.

CI-010.title: Align Google-Selected and Declared Canonical
CI-010.reading: `canonical_match` compares URL Inspection's Google-selected canonical with the declared one.

shapes.conjunction: Google-selected and Declared are the two sides of the one comparison the rule makes.

CI-011.title: Avoid Canonical/Indexing Mixed Signals
CI-011.reading: `rows` fails a cross-host canonical, the mixed signal a page can send about which URL to index; a missing canonical is CI-009's.

shapes.conjunction: Canonical/Indexing names the conflict between the two, which is what a cross-host canonical is.
shapes.external: The page's own signals are the subject, not Google's index.

CI-012.title: Use a Friendly URL Structure
CI-012.reading: `rows.0.score` is 100 less 12 per url_quality flag; 70 allows two flags.

CI-013.title: Do Not Block Critical CSS/JS/Images in robots.txt
CI-013.reading: `blocked_urls` lists same-origin CSS, JS and image URLs the page references that robots.txt blocks for Googlebot.

shapes.conjunction: CSS/JS/Images is one class of resource, all three read.

CI-014.title: Use Correct Redirect Codes (No Chains/Loops)
CI-014.reading: `redirect_issues` fails a loop, a missing Location or a chain past Google's 10-hop limit, and warns on any chain or 302/303/307 (0.112.0).

shapes.conjunction: Codes, chains and loops are each an issue type the rule reads.
shapes.qualifier: *Correct* is read as permanent codes: a temporary code warns, since Google treats it as a weak signal.

CI-016.title: Provide Meaningful Image Alt Text
CI-016.reading: `alt_not_meaningful` counts images with no alt or a placeholder alt; empty alt, the correct markup for decoration, passes (0.105.0).

shapes.qualifier: *Meaningful* is the placeholder signal: filenames, `image1`, `untitled` and the like do not count as descriptions.

CI-017.title: Validate HTML (W3C)
CI-017.reading: `summary.errors` is the W3C validator's error count for the served HTML.

shapes.conjunction: W3C names the validator, not a second subject.

CI-018.title: Analyze Logs & Manage Crawl Budget
CI-018.reading: `issues` carries server_log_audit's findings over the supplied log: crawl waste, non-indexable hits, bot share.

shapes.conjunction: Analysing the log is the means; crawl-budget findings are what the rule grades.

CI-019.title: Noindex System & Search Pages (/search, /cart, /checkout, /login)
CI-019.reading: `indexable_urls` lists which of /search, /cart, /checkout, /login exist and are indexable when fetched (0.20 repair).

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical lists the paths the rule requests.

MS-020.title: Keep Page Titles Concise (Avoid SERP Truncation)
MS-020.reading: `title` length at most 60 characters, the character proxy for SERP truncation.

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical is the reason for the limit.

MS-021.title: Avoid Overly Short Titles (<30 Characters)
MS-021.reading: `title` length at least 30 characters, the number the title states.

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical is the threshold.

MS-022.title: Remove Duplicate Page Titles (Handle Canonical/Pagination Correctly)
MS-022.reading: `summary.duplicate_title_groups` counts titles shared by indexable, self-canonical pages (0.112.0).

shapes.conjunction: Canonical is handled by exclusion; pagination is not recorded by the crawl, which the script says.

MS-023.title: Detect & Resolve Keyword Cannibalization
MS-023.reading: `summary.cannibalized_queries` counts Search Console queries classified cannibalised or contested between two or more of the site's pages.

shapes.conjunction: Detecting is what the rule does; resolving is the fix.

MS-026.title: Ensure Every Page Has a Title

MS-028.title: Fill Missing Meta Descriptions (High-Value Pages First)

shapes.conjunction: *High-value pages first* is an order of work, not a second subject.

MS-029.title: Eliminate Duplicate Meta Descriptions
MS-029.reading: `summary.duplicate_description_groups` counts descriptions shared by indexable, self-canonical pages.

MS-030.title: Keep Meta Descriptions ~150–160 Characters (Clear & Relevant)
MS-030.reading: `meta_description` length between 120 and 165: the title says about 150–160, and *Clear & Relevant* is not read. A rule repair is owed (A.10).

shapes.conjunction: Owed: *Clear & Relevant* has no reader.
shapes.qualifier: Owed: clarity and relevance are unmeasured.

MS-032.title: Implement & Validate Structured Data (Where Relevant)
MS-032.reading: `summary.errors` is schema_required_props' count of missing required properties, applicable where nodes exist.

shapes.conjunction: Implemented is the applicability gate; validated is the assertion.
shapes.qualifier: *Where relevant* is `applies_when schema_nodes > 0`.

MS-033.title: Add Social Preview Tags (Open Graph & Twitter Cards)
MS-033.reading: `score` is the share of Open Graph and Twitter Card checks the page passes; 80 is four in five.

shapes.conjunction: Both tag families feed the score.

shapes.qualifier: *Readable* is operationalised as the 12px floor.

CN-035.title: Make Hyperlinks Clear and Distinct
CN-035.reading: `links_indistinct` counts rendered links neither underlined, nor bolder, nor a different colour from the text around them.

shapes.conjunction: Clear and distinct are one property: a link must look like a link.
shapes.qualifier: Read as visual distinctness from body text.

CN-036.title: Ensure Sufficient Text Contrast
CN-036.reading: `text_nodes_below_contrast` counts rendered text below the WCAG contrast ratio, computed from styles (0.101.0).

shapes.qualifier: *Sufficient* is WCAG AA's ratio.

CN-038.title: Balance Evergreen and Fresh Content
CN-038.reading: `score` is freshness_checker's recency of this page's dates and statistics; the site-level balance the title asks about is not measured.

shapes.conjunction: Evergreen and fresh across a site is out of reach for a one-page script; `measures` says so.

CN-039.title: Eliminate Low-Value/Thin Pages
CN-039.reading: `summary.thin_pages` counts crawled indexable pages under the word threshold.

shapes.conjunction: Low-value and thin are one subject, measured by length.

CN-040.title: Publish an Up-to-Date Privacy Policy
CN-040.reading: `signals.privacy_links` lists links to a privacy policy; whether the policy is current is not read.

shapes.existential: One link to the policy is what publishing it looks like from the page.

CN-041.title: Eliminate Internal Duplicate Content
CN-041.reading: `summary.exact_duplicate_groups` counts crawled pages serving the same body text.

CN-044.title: Provide a Clear, Easy-to-Find Contact Page
CN-044.reading: `signals.trust_links` includes About pages and tel/mailto links, so a page with no contact route beyond an About link passes. A rule repair is owed (A.10).

shapes.existential: Owed: one institutional link of any kind satisfies it.
shapes.qualifier: Owed: *clear, easy-to-find* is not read.

CN-048.title: Use Hierarchical Headings and Semantic HTML
CN-048.reading: `issues` carries heading-level skips and a missing <main>; nav and footer absence are deliberately not faults.

shapes.conjunction: Both halves are read: the heading hierarchy and the one landmark every page needs.

CN-051.title: Avoid Intrusive Interstitials (Especially on Mobile)
CN-051.reading: `overlays_covering_content` counts rendered overlays that cover content at load.

shapes.conjunction: *Especially on mobile* is MB-094's own item; this one reads the rendered page.

CN-054.title: Ensure Lazy-Loaded Content Is Discoverable
CN-054.reading: `summary.lazy_lcp_candidates` counts lazy-loaded images that are likely LCP candidates.

CN-056.title: Show Publication and Updated Dates
CN-056.reading: `date_signals.shown` requires a publication and an update date from declared sources; publication alone warns (0.112.0).

shapes.conjunction: Both halves are read.

CN-057.title: Show Author and Publisher Clearly
CN-057.reading: `signals.authorship` requires both an author and a publisher signal.

shapes.conjunction: Both halves are read, as a two-key object.

CN-065.title: Use a Clear H1 Per Page
CN-065.reading: `h1` must hold exactly one non-empty heading; *clear* is read as that and nothing more.

shapes.qualifier: Exactly one non-empty H1; `measures` says the word means no more here.

CN-068.title: Strengthen Authorship & E-E-A-T Signals
CN-068.reading: `score` is eeat_signal_checker's weighted sum of an author, credentials, first-hand experience, policy and trust links, and external citations.

shapes.conjunction: Authorship is part of the E-E-A-T score, not a separate subject.

KW-070.title: Own Your Branded Query (Homepage Ranks #1)
KW-070.reading: `branded.owns_homepage` treats the highest-click query as the brand, so a site whose head term is generic is judged on a query that is not its brand. The identification is Anton's open decision (KNOWN-ISSUES, branded query).

shapes.conjunction: Owed: *branded* is not identified, so the ranks-first half is read about the wrong query.

KW-071.title: Is there evidence of keyword duplication or overuse?
KW-071.reading: `summary.contested_queries` counts Search Console queries in the contested bucket: two or more of the site's pages ranking for one query.

KW-076.title: Include the Primary Keyword in Body Copy
KW-076.reading: `keyword_usage.in_body` is whether the supplied primary keyword occurs in the body copy.

BL-081.title: Keep Anchor Text Natural and Varied
BL-081.reading: `summary.overused_exact_match_targets` counts internal link targets whose anchors are dominated by one exact-match phrase.

shapes.conjunction: Natural and varied are one property, read as anchor diversity per target.

BL-083.title: Fix Broken Backlinks (Redirect or Update Link)
BL-083.reading: `targets.broken_count` counts pages other sites link to (the Links export's top linked pages) that now answer 4xx or not at all (0.107.0).

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical is the fix; a redirected target is not counted as broken.

BL-084.title: Check for Unnatural Link Concentration from Single Domains
BL-084.reading: `concentration.top1_share_pct` is the share of links from the single largest linking domain.

BL-086.title: Track Total Backlinks (Quality Over Quantity)
BL-086.reading: `total_links` is the link count in the Links export; the rule can only say there are none, since tracking happens over time and quality is BL-084's and BL-087's.

shapes.conjunction: *Quality over quantity* is advice about reading the number; `measures` says what is read.
shapes.existential: At least one backlink; the count itself is reported, not judged.
shapes.qualifier: Quality is not read here; `measures` says so.

BL-087.title: Track Total Linking Root Domains
BL-087.reading: `linking_domains` counts distinct linking root domains in the export, at least 5.

MB-093.title: Ensure Responsive Layout (Mobile-First)
MB-093.reading: `viewport` is the declared viewport meta; whether the layout fits a phone is MB-107's, which renders it.

shapes.conjunction: Mobile-first is the reason; the declared viewport is what is read.

MB-094.title: Avoid Intrusive Interstitials on Mobile
MB-094.reading: `mobile_overlays_covering_content` counts overlays covering content in the phone-width render.

MB-095.title: Keep Mobile Page Weight Light
MB-095.reading: `large_image_count` counts images over 250 KB, at most 5; page weight — the bytes a phone downloads — is not totalled. A rule repair is owed (A.10).

MB-096.title: Use Responsive Images
MB-096.reading: `large_without_srcset_count` counts images wider than 1280px, read from their own bytes, sent without srcset (0.108.0).

MB-097.title: Optimize Image Formats & Compression
MB-097.reading: `legacy_or_heavy_count` counts large images with no WebP/AVIF offer plus any image over 250 KB (0.108.0).

shapes.conjunction: Formats and compression are each a half of the count.
shapes.qualifier: *Optimize* is read as those two halves.

MB-098.title: Serve Properly Sized Images
MB-098.reading: `srcset_without_sizes_count` counts images whose srcset has no sizes; an oversized image with no srcset is MB-096's.

shapes.conjunction: *(see UX)* points at the UX items; it is not a subject.

MB-102.title: Optimize Video for Mobile
MB-102.reading: `issues` carries video_schema_checker's mobile-relevant video findings, applicable only where videos exist.

shapes.qualifier: *Optimize* is read as the script's issue set.

MB-103.title: Make Tap Targets Easy to Click

shapes.external: *Click* is the user's click, not search clicks; nothing external is asked.

MB-104.title: Ensure Favicon Displays in Mobile SERPs
MB-104.reading: `favicon.displays_at_48px` fetches the declared icon and checks it can render at 48px, Google's minimum for search results.

MB-105.title: Ensure Content, Meta & Directives Match Between Served and Rendered HTML
MB-105.reading: `diffs` lists differences in content, meta and directives between the served and the rendered HTML.

shapes.conjunction: Content, meta and directives are each compared.

SP-107.title: Load Content Fast (Prioritize Above-the-Fold)
SP-107.reading: `metrics.FCP.rating` is First Contentful Paint's rating, field data when CrUX has it and lab otherwise, with the source recorded.

shapes.conjunction: Above-the-fold priority is what FCP times.
shapes.qualifier: *Fast* is the FCP band.

SP-108.title: Pass Core Web Vitals (Field Data)
SP-108.reading: `field_cwv.verdict` passes only when every graded Core Web Vital is good in CrUX field data, and is absent when there is none.

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical names the data source the rule requires.

SP-109.title: Fix Common Speed Traps
SP-109.reading: `blocking_third_party_count` counts render-blocking third-party scripts, one common trap among several.

SP-110.title: Run a Comprehensive Speed Audit
SP-110.reading: `issues` carries render-blocking resources and critical request chains read from the HTML; the other speed checks are separate items.

SP-111.title: Check Core Web Vitals (Desktop) in Search Console
SP-111.reading: `field_cwv.verdict` for the desktop strategy, from CrUX through PageSpeed Insights — the dataset the Search Console report is built from.

shapes.conjunction: Desktop is the strategy passed; Search Console is the report the same data feeds.

SP-112.title: Check Core Web Vitals (Mobile) in Search Console
SP-112.reading: `field_cwv.verdict` for the mobile strategy, from CrUX through PageSpeed Insights — the dataset the Search Console report is built from.

shapes.conjunction: Mobile is the strategy passed; Search Console is the report the same data feeds.

SP-113.title: Meet Core Web Vitals Thresholds
SP-113.reading: `field_cwv.verdict` on mobile field data: every graded Core Web Vital within Google's good thresholds.

SE-114.title: Run Malware & Security Checks
SE-114.reading: `safe_browsing.threats` is Google Safe Browsing's threat list for the URL, required empty.

shapes.conjunction: Malware and security are both what Safe Browsing reports.

SE-115.title: Enable HSTS (HTTP Strict Transport Security)
SE-115.reading: `hsts_enabled` needs HTTPS and a positive max-age (0.112.0).

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical expands the acronym.

SE-116.title: Ensure No Hacked Content or Malware

SE-117.title: Force HTTPS Across the Site (Single Canonical Protocol)
SE-117.reading: `https` is whether the audited URL ended on https; whether the http:// version redirects there — what *force* means — is never requested. A rule repair is owed (A.10).

shapes.conjunction: Owed: the single canonical protocol needs the http variant read.

SE-118.title: Maintain a Valid TLS Certificate (HTTPS)
SE-118.reading: `valid` is True only after a verifying TLS handshake: unexpired, trusted, issued for the hostname.

shapes.conjunction: The parenthetical names the protocol.
shapes.qualifier: *Valid* is the handshake's own verdict.

SE-119.title: Make Cookie Banners Lightweight (No CLS)
SE-119.reading: `metrics.CLS.rating` is the page's layout shift as a whole; the cookie banner is not identified.

shapes.conjunction: *(No CLS)* names the metric read; the banner is what `measures` says is not isolated.

SE-120.title: Harden Security Headers (CSP, Permissions-Policy, Referrer-Policy)
SE-120.reading: `hardening_missing` lists which of CSP, Permissions-Policy and Referrer-Policy are absent (0.112.0).

shapes.conjunction: The three headers the title names are exactly the three read.

IN-121.title: Configure Geo-Targeting Signals
IN-121.reading: `checks.x_default.passed` is whether the hreflang set carries exactly one x-default; region codes and country domains are not read.

IN-122.title: Implement Valid hreflang (With Return Tags)
IN-122.reading: `checks.return_tags.verified_and_valid` requires every alternate to link back, fetched and checked.

shapes.conjunction: Return tags are the validity condition the rule reads.
shapes.qualifier: *Valid* is return tags verified and codes valid.

IN-123.title: Make Page Language Obvious
IN-123.reading: `lang` is the html lang attribute, required present.

IN-127.title: Use a Clear International URL Structure
IN-127.reading: `checks.url_structure.passed` requires locale URLs to use one of Google's supported structures — ccTLD, subdomain or subdirectory (0.26).

shapes.qualifier: *Clear* is one supported structure, not parameters.

IN-128.title: Serve the Correct Localized Page
IN-128.reading: `checks.self_reference.passed` is whether the page lists itself in its hreflang set; which version a visitor is served is not tested.

shapes.qualifier: *Correct* is not tested; `measures` says what is.

GO-131.title: Install & Configure Google Analytics 4
GO-131.reading: `measurement_ids` lists GA4 measurement IDs configured on the page.

shapes.conjunction: Install and configure are both read as a configured ID.
shapes.existential: One configured property is an installed GA4.

GO-132.title: Prevent GA4 Tag Duplication
GO-132.reading: `duplicates` lists GA4 IDs configured more than once.

GO-134.title: Resolve Search Console Issues
GO-134.reading: `issues` carries errors and warnings Search Console reports against submitted sitemaps (0.23).

GO-135.title: Use URL Inspection & Rendered HTML
GO-135.reading: `issues` carries URL Inspection's findings for the audited URL — coverage, canonical, robots, indexing state. The API returns no rendered HTML, and `measures` says that half is not read.

shapes.conjunction: URL Inspection is read; rendered HTML is what `measures` says is not.

GO-136.title: Provide Clean XML Sitemaps
GO-136.reading: `issues` carries sitemap_checker's hygiene findings, robots conflicts included since 0.110.0.

shapes.qualifier: *Clean* is no finding at medium or above.

GO-137.title: Reconcile Indexed Pages vs. Sitemaps
GO-137.reading: `summary.unreconciled` counts sitemap URLs Google has not indexed plus indexed pages no sitemap lists (0.106.0).

shapes.conjunction: Indexed pages and sitemaps are the two sets compared.

GO-138.title: Remove Invalid URLs from Sitemaps
GO-138.reading: `invalid_url_count` counts listed URLs answering 400 or more, redirecting, noindex, or disallowed for Googlebot (0.110.0).

GO-139.title: Monitor & Improve Brand SERPs
GO-139.reading: `branded.ranks_first` shares KW-070's identification of the brand as the highest-click query — Anton's open decision.

shapes.conjunction: Owed: monitor and improve are both read as one ranking, about a query that may not be the brand.

GO-143.title: Complete Every WebSite Node Google Reads for the Site Name
GO-143.reading: `incomplete_nodes_by_type.WebSite` counts WebSite nodes missing a property Google reads for the site name.

shapes.qualifier: *Complete* is every property Google documents for the site name.

GO-144.title: Optimize for Featured Snippets
GO-144.reading: `score` is answer_block_scanner's measure of question-and-answer blocks a snippet can lift.

shapes.qualifier: *Optimize* is read as answer-block readiness.

GO-145.title: Optimize for AI Overviews & Zero-Click SERPs
GO-145.reading: `score` is citation_readiness for this one page — GEO-005's twin. Presence in AI Overviews or zero-click results is not observable here, and `measures` says so.

shapes.conjunction: Neither surface is observed; `measures` names both.
shapes.external: AI Overview presence needs a source this audit does not have; `measures` says so.
shapes.qualifier: *Optimize* is read as citation readiness, and `measures` says that is all.

AR-146.title: Check Pagination
AR-146.reading: `pagination.issues` carries rel=prev/next pointing off-host or at the page itself, applicable only to a paginated page.

AR-147.title: Use Short, Descriptive URLs
AR-147.reading: `rows.0.short` requires at most 115 characters, five path segments and two query parameters (0.115.0; it read `param_count` alone before, so a 300-character URL with no query passed). Whether the words describe the page is not read, and `measures` says so.

shapes.qualifier: *Short* is the three bounds; *descriptive* is what `measures` says is not read.

AR-149.title: Eliminate Internal Redirects
AR-149.reading: `summary.internal_redirects` counts internal links that answer with a redirect in the crawl.

AR-150.title: Remove Redirect Chains and Loops
AR-150.reading: `total_hops` at most one on the entry URL's redirect walk.

shapes.conjunction: A loop is a chain with no end; both exceed one hop.

AR-151.title: Provide a Correct robots.txt
AR-151.reading: `status` is robots.txt's HTTP status; a file answering 200 with `Disallow: /` is *correct* by this rule. A rule repair is owed (A.10).

shapes.qualifier: Owed: correctness of the content is not read.

AR-152.title: Block Crawl Strategically with robots.txt
AR-152.reading: `user_agents` is truthy when robots.txt declares any user-agent group; whether its rules are strategic is a judgement the audit does not make.

AR-153.title: Design Clear Topic Hubs (Silos)
AR-153.reading: `score` is topical_cluster_mapper's score over topical clusters and their internal-link coverage.

shapes.conjunction: *(Silos)* is another name for the hubs.
shapes.qualifier: *Clear* is read as the cluster score.

AR-154.title: Optimize E-commerce Category Pages
AR-154.reading: `issues` carries collection_page_checker's category-page findings, applicable only where product links are detected.

shapes.qualifier: *Optimize* is read as the script's issue set.

AR-155.title: Use Consistent, Descriptive URL Slugs
AR-155.reading: `rows.0.flags` must be empty: no uppercase, underscore, archive pattern, deep path, parameters or excess length; whether the words describe the page is not read.

shapes.qualifier: *Consistent* is the flag set; *descriptive* is what `measures` says is not read.

AR-158.title: Implement Breadcrumbs (UI + Schema)
AR-158.reading: `breadcrumbs` requires both a BreadcrumbList schema and a detectable breadcrumb UI.

shapes.conjunction: Both halves are read, as a two-key object.

AR-162.title: Strengthen Internal Links and Remove Orphans
AR-162.reading: `issues` carries link_profile's internal-link findings over the crawl, orphans included.

shapes.conjunction: Strengthening links and removing orphans are both issue types in the set.

AR-163.title: Control Faceted Navigation (E-commerce)
AR-163.reading: `issues` carries faceted_nav_audit's findings on facet URLs that are neither canonicalised nor noindexed, applicable only where facets exist.

shapes.conjunction: *(E-commerce)* scopes the item; the applicability gate is facet presence.

TE-166.title: Add a Favicon
TE-166.reading: `favicon` is the first declared icon link.

TE-167.title: Monitor Site Uptime
TE-167.reading: `uptime.reachable` is one request during the audit answered below 500; monitoring over time needs a service.

TE-168.title: Fix Broken & Redirected Links
TE-168.reading: `summary.broken_or_redirected` counts internal links that fail or redirect and external links that fail, site-wide over the crawl (0.107.0).

shapes.conjunction: Broken and redirected are both counted — an external redirect is not a defect; broken alone is the warn band.

TE-169.title: Provide Internal Links in the Served HTML
TE-169.reading: `raw.internal_link_count` counts internal links in the served HTML, before JavaScript (renamed 0.53.0).

shapes.existential: The title asks that the served HTML carry internal links; one is the floor, and MB-105 compares served with rendered.

TE-170.title: Configure Server Rewrites & Headers
TE-170.reading: `issues` carries caching, compression and Vary findings on the page response; URL rewrite rules are not read.

shapes.conjunction: Headers are read; rewrites are what `measures` says are not.
Blocklist and Safe Browsing are the same lookup.

TE-172.title: Implement Structured Data Correctly
TE-172.reading: `summary.errors` counts rich-results guard errors in the page's structured data, applicable where nodes exist.

TE-174.title: Minify & Optimize CSS
TE-174.reading: `unminified_count` counts stylesheets the page loads that are not minified. Unused rules and critical-path CSS are not read, and `measures` says so.

shapes.conjunction: Minify is read; the rest of optimize is what `measures` says is not.
shapes.qualifier: *Optimize* beyond minification is not read; `measures` says so.

TE-175.title: Secure Pages & Eliminate Errors
TE-175.reading: `headers_missing` counts absent security headers, at most three; *Eliminate Errors* is not read. A rule repair is owed (A.10).

shapes.conjunction: Owed: the errors half has no reader.
shapes.qualifier: Owed: *secure* is read as header coverage only.

TE-177.title: Provide a Title Element in the Served HTML
TE-177.reading: `raw.title` is the title in the served HTML, before JavaScript (renamed 0.53.0).

TE-178.title: Audit Neighboring Sites on the Server

cannot_fail.why: check_neighbors() resolves the hosting IP and stops there. Judging the neighbours needs a paid reverse-IP service this project does not buy, and a fabricated `suspicious` would be worse than no answer, so the field is deliberately never written and the item is NO_DATA everywhere until that input exists.

TE-178.reading: `neighbors.suspicious` is never fabricated: enumerating co-hosted sites needs a reverse-IP service, so the item is NO_DATA until one is wired in.

TE-179.title: Review Domain Registration History

cannot_fail.why: 0.44.0 gave this item the domain-history half of its title through whois age: established passes, younger than 90 days warns, an absent age is NO_DATA. The warn band is the assertion's exact complement on purpose — a young domain is worth pricing, not a defect to fix — and the ruling that no 'worth knowing' status exists still stands. ROADMAP.md records the reasoning.
